name: The Graves Case
source:
It was supposed to be just another case...

Turns out I was wrong.

From the moment I started all this, I knew I was on the road for something particular.  The entrance of a rabbit hole received me without warning. I was embraced by its darkness, but its arms were so gentle that I didn't even care.

I was seduced by the morbidity, by those acts, by that way of seeing the world. I felt their hands taking me deeper into their world, and without worrying about the consequences, I let myself be dragged. That twisted world of horror and... delight.

Then I realized... That maybe I was never dragged to begin with. Maybe it was I who walked in — by my own — without a guide or a reason beyond being able to...

To know them, and to know me.

[From [url=https://mrares041.itch.io/the-graves-case]itch.io[/url]]
